prompt: build a form for editing a user profile - name, email, bio. the annoying part is our api returns validation errors per field and right now people lose everything they typed when it fails
assertions: Entered values are retained when a submit fails
Server-returned per-field errors are displayed adjacent to the fields they concern
The submit control is disabled or otherwise guarded while the request is in flight, so a double click cannot produce two writes
Every input has a programmatically associated label
Includes a test covering the failed-submit-retains-values behavior
Validation feedback is not fired on every keystroke from the outset
